notes.title: Update and open test in Google Play
notes.notes:
Hello dear players, today there is a new small update and an open test in the Google Play store, here's what has changed in this update:
[list]
[*] Added difficulty levels
[*] Bug fix in inventory
[*] Flashlight fix
[*] Some optimization
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]
Now about the open test, in order to take part in it, you need to sign up for it using this link: https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.CaTaTo.HelloFromDarkness
there or here you can download the game: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.CaTaTo.HelloFromDarkness
It will be free to play on the Google Play store, but in-game ads will be added after the open test ends.

notes.title: Where is the update?
notes.notes: Hello dear players, I am sure you are looking forward to the new update. Forced to disappoint you, there will be no new content in it, only some fixes :(. This is due to the fact that the majority of our small team found a permanent job, in particular, our main modeler, who has not been able to finish a new location for several months. Therefore, I decided to experiment with outputs to different platforms, in particular, I announce the release of this game to the Google Play Store on devices running Android and ChromeOS. I wanted and want to release a new update along with a general beta test, but the store has not been able to test our game for a week. So if he doesn't check it by May 30, I will release the update to Steam without an open test on Android.

notes.title: Plans for a future update
notes.notes:
Hello dear players again, I would like to share with you what we are planning to release in the next update, it should be released approximately in the middle or end of next month, but maybe even earlier:
[list]
[*] 2 new levels 1 of which is coordially different from the rest of the gameplay
[*] support for windows 32 platform, now the game can run on a 32-bit version of windows
[*] first level update
[*]difficulty levels
[/list]

notes.title: Do you want console in the next update? :)
A little about the upcoming update
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players, yes, yes, I know you are waiting for the update :) But you still have to wait, the bulk of the work, namely the 3D models, we have done 80%, do not think that the update will be released tomorrow or in a week. We want to make this update long enough. I can't say the exact or even approximate release dates, but we will do our best to do it as soon as possible. By the way, I almost forgot, here are a couple of screenshots for you so that you are not so sad :D we will try to send something here more often.
